name: LiveUXI GSC Connect
author: LiveUXI

sections.description:
LiveUXI GSC Connect finds your site’s sitemap (core wp-sitemap.xml, robots.txt Sitemap lines, and common SEO-plugin paths), lets you add or remove URLs, and helps you submit it to Google Search Console.

Free (wordpress.org)

  • Detect sitemap candidates (robots.txt + common URLs)
  • Prefer the best match (sitemap index vs urlset)
  • Copy full sitemap URL and path-only form for GSC
  • Deep link into Google Search Console for your property
  • Sitemap content controls: toggle posts/pages/taxonomies/authors, add custom URLs, exclude URLs or post IDs
  • Detection details table (HTTP status, kind, entry count, latency)
  • Public status JSON at /wp-json/lxgsc/v1/status
  • In-plugin Support and Documentation buttons
  • Works without Google API keys

Pro (LiveUXI Stripe license gateway)

  • Google OAuth connection to Search Console
  • Automatic sitemap submit and status sync
  • Indexing API helpers for priority URLs
  • Multi-property management
  • Activate with a LiveUXI license key (no Freemius)

WordPress.org does not sell paid plugins. The free plugin is complete for manual submission. Pro is optional and distributed outside wordpress.org.

Demo: https://wordpress.liveuxi.com/
Docs: https://wordpress.liveuxi.com/docs/gsc-connect/
Support: plugins@liveuxi.com

External services

This plugin can contact LiveUXI services operated by LiveUXI Ltd. Free sitemap detection and local controls work without any LiveUXI account.

LiveUXI license verification

When you enter a Pro license key, the plugin sends the license key, site URL, and plugin slug to https://liveuxi.com/api/lxstore/v1/license/verify so LiveUXI can confirm the key is valid for this site. That request runs only when you activate (or re-check) a license.

LiveUXI Stripe checkout

The optional “Go Pro” / upgrade links open LiveUXI’s checkout pages on liveuxi.com so you can purchase a Pro license. Checkout is handled by LiveUXI / Stripe; the free plugin does not process card details itself.

LiveUXI terms: https://liveuxi.com/terms-conditions
LiveUXI privacy policy: https://liveuxi.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/liveuxi-gsc-connect/ or install the ZIP via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to Settings → GSC Connect → Detect sitemap.
  4. Under “What is in the sitemap”, toggle content types and add/remove URLs as needed.
  5. Copy the URL and paste it into Google Search Console → Sitemaps.
  6. Use Support or Documentation if you need help.
sections.faq:
Does this require a Google API key?

No for free features. Pro OAuth requires a Google Cloud OAuth client (site owner or LiveUXI-managed).

Will this work with Yoast / Rank Math sitemaps?

Detection reads robots.txt Sitemap lines and probes common paths including sitemap_index.xml and sitemap.xml.

Where do I buy Pro?

Use the Upgrade / Go Pro link in the plugin (LiveUXI Stripe checkout). Not sold on wordpress.org.

How do I get support?

Email plugins@liveuxi.com, or use the Support button on Settings → GSC Connect. Docs: https://wordpress.liveuxi.com/docs/gsc-connect/

Why is detection failing?

Turn off Settings → Reading → “Discourage search engines from indexing this site”. Confirm /wp-sitemap.xml loads in a browser.
